context_requirements: Active PI3K-AKT signaling, typically from PTEN loss, PIK3CA mutation, or RTK/oncogene activation
Dependence on AKT for survival and proliferation
Intact downstream FOXO and mTORC1 signaling to mediate transcriptional output
falsifiers: No decrease in proliferation or cell-cycle genes at 24 h in PTEN-mutant or PIK3CA-mutant lines
No induction of FOXO target genes such as TSC22D3, DDIT4, or SESN1 at 6 h
Strong transcriptional response in HA1E or other lines without PI3K-AKT activation
No difference in response between PTEN/PIK3CA-mutant and wild-type lines

evidence.supports: MK-2206 inhibits Akt and synergistically inhibits proliferation of human cancer cell lines
GDC-0068 blocks Akt signaling, reduces viability, and sensitivity correlates with PTEN loss or PIK3CA mutation
MK-2206 inhibits Akt signaling and cell-cycle progression; PTEN/PIK3CA mutations increase sensitivity
GSK690693 inhibits proliferation and induces apoptosis in hematologic cancer lines
MK-2206 activates autophagy and can promote apoptosis in glioma cells
